title: Araham
text: 2. Pañcimāni bhikkhave indriyāni || katamāni pañca || || Saddhindriyaṃ || pe || paññindriyaṃ || || 3. Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imesam pañcannam indriyānam Samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo-samadaññā vimutto ti || ||
